reviewNotes:
Hibira Chat is the mobile inbox for support agents of Hibira Live Chat (https://chat.hibira.io), a live chat service that businesses add to their own websites. Agents normally sign in with a link sent to their work email or with their company's single sign-on; there is no sign-up in the app, because workspace owners invite their agents from the web.

To review: enter the demo email below on the sign-in screen. Instead of sending an email, the app asks for a sign-in code: enter the demo password. The inbox then shows a sample shop's chats: one rated 5, one rated 2, and one visitor still waiting. Open a chat to read it, see its rating and reply. Agents get a push notification when a new chat arrives or a visitor replies.

The app sells nothing and has no in-app purchases; plans are managed by the workspace owner on the web, and billing pages are hidden in the app.
